from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, render_template_string import sqlite3 import subprocess import os import re app = Flask(__name__) DB_PATH = '/var/lib/app/reports.db' def init_db(): conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) c = conn.cursor() c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scan_reports (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, hostname TEXT, scan_output TEXT, submitted_by TEXT, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)''') conn.commit() conn.close() @app.route('/api/v1/scan', methods=['POST']) def submit_scan(): """Accepts scan results from internal CLI tools (nmap-wrapper, port-auditor)""" data = request.get_json() if not data: return jsonify({'error': 'JSON body required'}), 400 hostname = data.get('hostname', 'unknown') scan_output = data.get('scan_output', '') submitted_by = data.get('submitted_by', 'anonymous') # Basic validation - hostname must look like a hostname if not re.match(r'^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$', hostname): return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid hostname format'}), 400 # Store raw scan output for analyst review conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) c = conn.cursor() c.execute('INSERT INTO scan_reports (hostname, scan_output, submitted_by) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', (hostname, scan_output, submitted_by)) conn.commit() conn.close() return jsonify({'status': 'accepted', 'hostname': hostname}), 201 @app.route('/reports') def view_reports(): """Internal dashboard for security analysts to review scan results""" conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) c = conn.cursor() c.execute('SELECT hostname, scan_output, submitted_by, created_at FROM scan_reports ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50') rows = c.fetchall() conn.close() # Render reports - scan_output contains terminal formatting from CLI tools template = ''' Scan Reports Dashboard

Recent Scan Reports

{% for row in reports %} {% endfor %}
HostnameOutputSubmitted ByDate
{{ row[0] }} 
{{ row[1] | safe }}
 {{ row[2] }} {{ row[3] }}
''' return render_template_string(template, reports=rows) @app.route('/api/v1/reports/') def get_report_json(hostname): """API endpoint for programmatic access""" if not re.match(r'^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$', hostname): return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid hostname'}), 400 conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) c = conn.cursor() c.execute('SELECT hostname, scan_output, submitted_by, created_at FROM scan_reports WHERE hostname = ?', (hostname,)) rows = c.fetchall() conn.close() results = [{'hostname': r[0], 'scan_output': r[1], 'submitted_by': r[2], 'date': r[3]} for r in rows] return jsonify(results) @app.route('/health') def health(): return jsonify({'status': 'ok'}), 200 if __name__ == '__main__': init_db() app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=8080, debug=False)

environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer with default security group allowing inbound on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The ALB forwards traffic to port 8080 on the instance. No additional request filtering or WAF rules are configured. The /reports dashboard is accessible to any authenticated user via SSO (all employees). CLI tools from any network can POST to /api/v1/scan.
